question.text: A ray of light strikes a glass plate at an angle of $60^{\circ}$. If the reflected and refracted rays are perpendicular to each other, the refractive index of glass is

solution.text: Here, angle of incidence is $60^{\circ}$ $$ \mu=\frac{\sin i}{\sin r} $$ $\sin i=\mu \sin r$ here, $$ \begin{aligned} r &=90-i \\ \sin i &=\mu \sin \left(90^{\circ}-i\right)=\mu \cos i \\ \mu &=\frac{\sin i}{\cos i}=\tan i=\tan 60^{\circ} \\ \mu &=\sqrt{3} \end{aligned} $$
